units.source_text: 老名人的感冒总算痊愈了。

en.t: The old Master finally recovered from his cold.

units.source_text: 年轻的七段却毛病百出。

en.t: The young seventh-dan player, however, was beset by all sorts of ailments.

units.source_text: 比起名人来，七段显得更加神经质。

en.t: Compared with the Master, the seventh-dan player seemed even more nervous and sensitive.

units.source_text: 他们两人的体质不能单从外表来看。

en.t: The constitutions of the two men could not be judged by appearances alone.

units.source_text: 名人一离开对局室，就想尽力把棋局忘却，沉溺在别的比赛中。

en.t: As soon as the Master left the game room, he tried his best to forget the match and lose himself in other contests.

units.source_text: 在自己的房间里，他不再接触棋子。

en.t: In his own room, he no longer touched the game pieces.

units.source_text: 而七段即使在休息日，也要面对棋盘，孜孜不倦地研究暂停的棋路。

en.t: The seventh-dan player, on the other hand, would sit before the board even on rest days, tirelessly studying the suspended line of play.

units.source_text: 这可能不光是年龄相异，风度也各不相同吧。

en.t: This was probably not merely a difference in age, but also a difference in bearing.
